channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Skoda Peaq Revealed: The Brand's First Real Electric Flagship
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefuhl walks through the Skoda Peaq, a five and seven seat electric SUV with two battery sizes, a claimed 400 to 500 km of real-world range and a cabin pitched as proper luxury.

item.title: Can a $1,500 Plug-In Battery Stand In for a Powerwall?
item.dc:creator: Undecided with Matt Ferrell
item.description: Matt Ferrell, who discloses he advises the company, tests Pila, a $1,499 home battery that plugs into a standard outlet with no electrician or permit, and notes where regulation still limits it.

item.title: Volvo ES90 First Look: A Big Electric Saloon Making the Efficiency Case
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: Everything Electric drives the five meter Volvo ES90, a luxury saloon with up to 411 miles of range and fast 800 volt charging, arguing a saloon shape beats an equivalent SUV on efficiency.

item.title: McMurtry Says Amateurs Set Two Lap Records in Its Electric Fan Car
item.dc:creator: McMurtry Automotive
item.description: McMurtry took its Speirling fan car to Denmark and says a visiting journalist and a private owner each set a venue lap record during dealer track days, with the car running below full power.

item.title: Urtopia Carbon Classic ST: A 38-Pound Carbon E-Bike With Real Power
item.dc:creator: Electroheads
item.description: Electroheads rides the Urtopia Carbon Classic ST around Menlo Park, a 38 pound carbon e-bike with a step-through frame, a 750W peak motor, a throttle and a claimed range of up to 75 miles.

item.title: Zeekr 7 GT First Drive: The Estate Car China Wants You to Notice
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying drives the Zeekr 7 GT in Spain. The dual-motor Privilege puts out 646 horsepower, hits 62 mph in 3.3 seconds and charges on an 800V system.

item.title: ALSO TM-B First Ride: Rivian's Spinoff Builds an E-Bike From Scratch
item.dc:creator: Irving Torres
item.description: Irving Torres rides the ALSO TM-B in San Diego. The Rivian spinoff e-bike is a Class 3 design built ground up with pedal-by-wire and regen braking.

item.title: One Year, 25,000 Miles: An Honest Rivian R1S Ownership Check-In
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec Reviews looks back on a year with a Rivian R1S after 25,000 miles, weighing the storage, towing and software against quality and autonomy gaps.

item.title: Renault Megane E-Tech Facelift Adds a Bigger Battery and Faster Charging
item.dc:creator: What Car?
item.description: What Car? walks through the updated Renault Megane E-Tech. A new 67 kWh LFP battery lifts range to 310 miles and DC charging rises to 165 kW.

item.title: The Tesla Model Y Accessories One Owner Says He Cannot Drive Without
item.dc:creator: Everyday Chris
item.description: Everyday Chris walks through the aftermarket accessories he adds to a Tesla Model Y, from floor mats and storage trays to a bigger Sentry Mode drive.

item.title: Romain Dumas Wins Pikes Peak Again in Ford's Electric Mustang
item.dc:creator: Pikes Peak International Hill Climb
item.description: According to a Pirelli release, Romain Dumas took the all-electric Ford Super Mustang Mach-E up the 19.99 km course in 8:18.202 for a sixth title, while pole-sitter Simone Faggioli finished third after a technical issue.

item.title: New BMW i3 Orders Open Early as Demand Outruns Supply
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: The Electrifying team says the launch-edition i3 opened for orders early on strong demand at under 58,000 pounds, alongside a 3.3-second Zeekr 7 GT and a roundup of the best open-top EVs for summer.

item.title: Flying the Pipistrel Taurus Electro, a Solar-Charged Electric Glider
item.dc:creator: Stefan Langer
item.description: Stefan Langer flies a side-by-side two-seat electric glider with just over 13 kWh on board, while his host charges both the aircraft and his EV from a homemade solar trailer.

item.title: 240 Miles in a 60-Mile Chevy Spark EV, Almost
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec BITS
item.description: Out of Spec BITS drives a 2016 Chevy Spark EV about 240 miles on ChargePoint stations only, and runs out of charge two miles short after a closed exit eats the buffer.

item.title: Rivian's RJ Scaringe on the R2, the Money, and No UK Date
item.dc:creator: Virgin Radio UK
item.description: Speaking to Virgin Radio, RJ Scaringe marks the R2 launch, says a roughly 45,000 dollar version arrives in summer 2027, and explains why there is no UK date yet.

item.title: One Year With a Heatable Solar and Battery Setup: What He Would Change
item.dc:creator: Andrew Till / Mr. EV
item.description: A UK owner reviews a year with 30 Australian-built panels and 20 kWh of Alpha ESS storage, covering cold-weather shutdowns, tight winter capacity and the upgrades he wishes he had picked.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
